summary: Guardian Pharmacy Services filed an 8-K on September 10, 2026 disclosing lock-up agreements with founders, executive officers and certain employees holding about 29.9 million Class A shares, roughly 81% of insider-held stock, effective through September 14, 2027 without company consent. The agreements precede the September 27, 2026 issuance of 13,521,396 Class A shares upon automatic conversion of the final Class B tranche, leaving 63,320,300 Class A shares outstanding. This is an ordinary share-overhang and transfer-restriction disclosure rather than a special situation; watch for future lock-up expiries and conversion-driven supply.
